verdict.rationale: Box hosts a live llms.txt at developer.box.com/llms.txt (confirmed by probe, HTTP 200) and separate agent-oriented docs like agent-configurator.md, plus documented MCP server and CLI access for agents to consume Box content. missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration that agents actually consume this llms.txt successfully in practice, and no evidence of llms-full.txt or broader agent-doc index beyond the single file.
